notes.title: Update 12/1/24
notes.content:
Update to fix some new bugs I discovered
- [spoiler]1D07[/spoiler]'s room no longer has weird collision issues
- The mushroom holding the key no longer can be killed before it drops the key
- Final door now says "opened" when you have all the keys
- [spoiler]Pong Boss[/spoiler]'s room isn't missing textures to the left
- removed a problematic vine that caused weird physics

notes.title: Update 6/16/24
notes.content:
Some bug fixes and QoL

Bug Fixes:
- Madmin boss should no longer start jumping extremely fast forever
- Should hopefully have fixed Beat Up Bear freeze on first time finding it
- Fixed some projectiles moving faster than supposed to

QoL:
- Zoom and Unzoom on map
- Dropping down a platform should be a little less odd

notes.content: Should make the post win Crimson and Rose act properly.
